assumptions: All parameters are illustrative, not calibrated to onion measurements.
D_eff is a constant effective dispersion coefficient, not measured LF molecular diffusivity.
Velocity is uniform and prescribed; no room, body, board, wall, buoyancy, sink, or return flow is resolved.
The 3D domain is all space, with initially zero concentration and decay at spatial infinity.
Source and observer are normalized Gaussian functions, with infinite support and stated coordinate standard deviations.
Total emitted amount is one unspecified unit; source amplitude is not a molar measurement.
The baseline passive scalar has no reaction or deposition loss; optional loss sensitivities are explicitly illustrative.
Observation is a mathematical spatial average, not ocular absorption or tear volume.
Source timing is imposed independently of flow, temperature, cutting, and droplet generation.
Sensitivity ranges are scenario ranges, not confidence intervals.
